'''January 2000 Williston Park tournament (8 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, New York on 8 January 2000. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-williston-park-new-york-01-08-00d164/ williston-park-new-york-01-08-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-williston-park-new-york-01-08-00d164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
